captions.multi_multipole_fisher_toy: [multi_multipole_fisher_toy] I = sum_{l=2..L} (2l+1)/2 * f_sky * r_l^2 (toy response) — a distinct information-theoretic object; never interchangeable with a single-estimator sampling dispersion.
captions.quadrupole_power_ideal: [quadrupole_power_ideal] Fractional sampling dispersion sqrt(2/5) of the full_sky, none-noise, isotropic_gaussian estimator C2_hat = (1/5) * sum_m |a_2m|^2 (ell = 2, reality-condition dof = 5). Estimator- and domain-specific; a different estimator or domain carries a different dispersion.
